sources.snippet: Clean up noisy speech in real time with DPDFNet - open-source streaming speech enhancement for research, audio apps, and edge devices. Includes pretrained models, PyTorch code, ONNX/TFLite inference, 8/16/48 kHz support, and live demos. - ceva-ip/DPDFNet

sources.snippet: Hint Use dpdfnet2_8khz or dpdfnet8_8khz for 8 kHz audio; dpdfnet_baseline, dpdfnet2, dpdfnet4, or dpdfnet8 for 16 kHz downstream ASR or speech recognition; and dpdfnet2_48khz_hr or dpdfnet8_48khz_hr for 48 kHz enhancement.
